payload.rationale: Per-capability fallback order could not say which family to try at a tier, least-lease spread burned quotas unpredictably, and family-keyed lease state mixed pools. Owner answers 2026-10-19 23:07 and 23:20 (problem-261017-0022). Reversal: back to least-lease if one account keeps hitting its quota while others idle; tier groups change when a family's model at a tier stops being equivalent. [Restated 2026-11-22: relation supersedes:0051 restated as amends:0051, classified by reading in the 2026-11-22 pkm roles probe.]
payload.text: D-ADR0071 (model pool B1): a seat walks its tier's declared family order after a failure (runner.tierFallback, capability prefer only narrows), cross-family fallback is on within the tier (doer tiers to cheap equivalent families, flagship/frontier to premium ones), accounts rotate in declared order (same pool first), lease/state/quarantine are keyed by pool, an account pins as pool/account, and a missing tier cell refuses tier-cell-missing. Partly supersedes runner record 0051 item 1 and 0058 items 2, 3, 6.
